query: Caitlyn Vinci LMT massage therapist Gainesville FL
name: Caitlyn Vinci LMT
niche: massage therapy / bodywork studio (licensed massage therapist)
address: 1624 NW 6th St, Gainesville, FL 32609, United States
bio: Caitlyn Vinci is a Licensed Massage Therapist (MA78940) who currently provides Table massage, Thai massage, Hot Stone massage, Hydrotherapy, and Therapeutic Cupping services at The House of Yin (MM37867). Blending Ayurvedic principles, Polarity, Relaxation, Connective tissue and Neuro-Muscular therapies, she takes an integrative approach to bodywork using many different styles and modalities to meet each client's specific needs. Caitlyn graduated from the Florida School of Massage (with a certification in Thai Massage from The Shala) and has had a practice rooted in the Gainesville, Florida community since 2015.
notes: Cupping can be added to any table or Thai session at no extra charge by writing 'Add Cupping' in the booking notes. Square.site booking page also mentions Hot Stone massage and Hydrotherapy as modalities Caitlyn practices, blended into table sessions, though they are not listed as separate bookable line items with their own price.
